base_dir.description: Root directory for grokevt configuration (as documented in grokevt(7))

systems.description:
List of Windows system configurations; each represents a profile directory under 'systems/' in base_dir (grokevt(7))

Each object defines:
- name: directory name for the system profile (e.g., hostname)
- drives: array of drive mappings (drive letter and Linux mount path)
- systemroot: Windows %SystemRoot% path (e.g., 'C:\Windows')
- registry_path: *NIX absolute path to SYSTEM registry hive (case-sensitive, under %SystemRoot%)
